messages:
alex: EOD async — quick status on audits/remediation. did a dry run of the KMS rotation scripts in staging and hit a perms error when trying to re-encrypt service accounts.

marta: which perms exactly?

alex: the role the script assumes was missing kms:Decrypt on the ekms-staging alias. error: "AccessDeniedException: decrypt failed". opened a PR to add the minimal permission.

marta: saw PR #482. left a comment: prefer kms:Decrypt scoped to the key ARN rather than wildcard.

cheng: nit: also avoid broad "kms:*". try: \`Action = [\"kms:Decrypt\"]\` and specify \`Resource = [\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd-...\"]\`.

alex: updated the IAM policy per Cheng and pushed. CI is failing on terraform fmt — fixing that now.

security-scan-bot: Snyk scan finished for repo redwood-infra: 2 high vulnerabilities found in third_party_lib@2.3.1. PR recommended: upgrade to 2.4.0. Details: https://snyk.io/vuln/XYZ-123

samira: I'm opening SEC-319 to track the dependency upgrade and impact analysis. checking if that library is used in any prod-facing path or only build tooling.

kevin: fyi the incident runbook was updated to include KMS rotation steps and rollback triggers — https://confluence.redwood.com/engsec/runbooks/kms-rotation :thumbsup:

marta: blocker: we still need a dedicated integration VM that can access the staging KMS under the same VPC rules. @ops-bot can you provision something small for the team to run the integration?

ops-bot: request received from marta. provisioning t3.small in prod-sandbox VPC, name=engsec-kms-test. ETA ~12 minutes. will post IP when ready.

cheng: for tomorrow I'll finish the IAM audit queries (least-privilege report) and hand results to Samira for review.

samira: perfect. I'll validate the query results and run a smoke test once the test VM is ready. if everything looks good we can schedule a canary rotation for next Thursday.

alex: proposed canary plan: rotate one key per region, route ~5% of traffic to the new key via feature flag, monitor errors and latency. automated rollback if error rate > 1% or decryption failures > 0.5%.

marta: I added a short checklist in #eng-security-docs (link in channel) for pre-canary checks — backlinks to that in the canary ticket. also tagging @kevin for SLA notes to customers for Dedicated tenants.

kevin: noted. I'll draft a short customer-facing note about transient latency and expected behavior during rotations and post a copy in the ticket.

alex: small snippet from the rotation script for reviewers: 
```bash
# schedule a staged rotation job
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id $KEY_ID --pending-window-in-days 7
# sanity check decrypt against staging service account
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload.bin --key-id $KEY_ID
```

cheng: thanks — looks fine. one suggestion: add exponential backoff retry on decrypt in the script.

samira: PRs that need attention before we can proceed: #482 (IAM perms), #485 (rotation script), #486 (dependency upgrade). please review by EOD tomorrow if possible.

alex: ack — planning to pair with Samira tomorrow 10:30 PT to run through the end-to-end.

marta: ops-bot just posted the VM IP. I'll add it to the integration ticket and kick off the smoke test after lunch.

ops-bot: VM provisioning complete: 10.20.5.12. SSH access granted to eng-security-sre group.

kevin: one more thing — reminder to add audit log entries for each rotation step so we have clear RBAC records. small compliance ask.

alex: added a logging step in the rotation pipeline to emit event to cloudwatch with key id, actor, and timestamp. sample: \`rotations.audit(\"key\": \"$KEY_ID\", \"actor\": \"$USER\")\`.

samira: great. closing this EOD — will follow up with PR statuses tomorrow. thanks everyone. :coffee:
